responsibility: Declares the assembler-output helper API used by DWARF, CTF, BTF, and unwind emitters to write debug-format data in target assembly syntax. It exposes functions for fixed-width data, raw byte output, symbol deltas and offsets, absolute and encoded addresses, nul-terminated strings, ULEB128/SLEB128 values, size computations for variable encodings, and management of indirect constants created for encoded addresses, forming the public interface to dwarf2asm.cc’s low-level serialization routines.
same_name_distinction: Declares the low-level DWARF/CTF/BTF assembler-output helper API that dwarf2asm.cc implements; it is the shared interface layer, not the target-specific emission logic or indirect-constant handling itself.
